enrichment.summary: Configures a Conditional Access policy to enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for all users and applications across all platforms, ensuring strong authentication methods are used.
enrichment.rationale: Enhances organisational security by requiring MFA, which mitigates the risk of unauthorised access due to compromised credentials. This policy ensures that all users authenticate using secure, multi-factor methods.
enrichment.userImpact: No visible change for users while the policy is disabled.
